annotations.title: Try one sample duplicate-invoice check (free, no key)

description: See what a spend check returns before you have a key. Runs ONE sample check on a fixed demo invoice: a duplicate match against an invoice paid earlier, required fields, and a sum check that the line items add up to the total. Call it once to learn the response shape. Do NOT call it on your own invoices (it ignores them; use check_duplicate_invoice) or in a loop: it is limited to 5 calls per hour per IP and per MCP session. Inputs: scenario (optional: duplicate, the default, clean, or bad_total). Returns: demo, scenario, invoice, earlier_invoice, duplicate.status (unique or duplicate), checks, next_step.action (pass, retry or escalate), note, next_action and request_id. No receipt and nothing is stored. Cost: free. Needs no key.

scenario.description: Which fixed demo invoice to check: duplicate (default; the same invoice sent again with a reformatted id), clean, or bad_total (the line items do not add up).
